name: After § 19
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 19a. Recalls that the former Commissioner entrusted with negotiating the anti-corruption framework for the rule of law reports is currently under investigation for money laundering and other corruption-related offences; denounces the fact that the non-governmental organisations (NGOs) taking part in the Commission’s annual rule of law report procedures were directly funded by the Commission and governments outside the EU, making the objectivity and impartiality of these reports highly questionable;
